settings.label: Server
settings.help: The ntfy server to listen to — ntfy.sh, or your own (http:// works too). Just the address: no username or password in it

settings.label: Topic
settings.help: Which topic to listen to. Letters, numbers, - and _ only, like ntfy itself. Treat it like a password: on a public server anyone who knows it can read your messages and send their own. Use a long random one. It's never shown on the display

settings.label: Tile name
settings.help: What the tile is called on the display, like GitHub or Backups. Handy when there's more than one ntfy tile

settings.label: Count announcements from the last
settings.help: A number and m, h or d (30m, 12h, 7d), or all. The tile counts what came in this window, and fetches it when connecting. Fetched messages never raise notifications

settings.label: Show notifications
settings.help: Pop up each new message on every display showing this face, with this server's address on top so you know where it came from
